[We are sequencing 1,000 long-read genomes from Indigenous and admixed ancestries across Latin America to find the structural variation that the current human reference genome misses, and to learn what it does in immune cells and in gallbladder cancer.]{.lede}
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
cohorts = FileAttachment("data/cohorts.csv").csv({typed: true})
places = FileAttachment("data/countries.csv").csv({typed: true})
topojson = require("topojson-client@3")
world = d3.json("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-110m.json")
land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.countries)
partnerColor = new Map(places.map(d => [d.atlas_name, d.color]))
dark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
totals = places.map(p => {
  const rows = cohorts.filter(d => d.country === p.country)
  return {...p, value: d3.sum(rows, d => d.lr_wgs ?? 0), n: rows.length}
}).filter(d => d.value > 0)

Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 760),
  height: Math.min(width, 760) * 1.05,
  projection: {
    type: "mercator",
    domain: {type: "MultiPoint", coordinates: [[-112, 30], [-36, -55]]},
    inset: 8
  },
  r: {range: [0, 34], domain: [0, 220]},
  marks: [
    Plot.geo(land, {fill: dark ? "#1E2D45" : "#E4E9EF", stroke: dark ? "#0E1A2E" : "#FFFFFF", strokeWidth: 0.6}),
    Plot.geo(land.features.filter(f => partnerColor.has(f.properties.name)), {
      fill: f => partnerColor.get(f.properties.name), fillOpacity: 0.4,
      stroke: dark ? "#0E1A2E" : "#FFFFFF", strokeWidth: 0.6
    }),
    Plot.dot(totals, {
      x: "lon", y: "lat", r: "value",
      fill: "color", stroke: dark ? "#E6ECF3" : "#14233C", strokeWidth: 1.2,
      title: d => `${d.country}\n${d.n} contributing cohort${d.n > 1 ? "s" : ""}`
    }),
    Plot.text(totals, {
      // label sits just right of each circle, so bigger circles push it further out
      x: d => d.lon + 0.8 + 3.6 * Math.sqrt(d.value / 220), y: "lat",
      text: "country", textAnchor: "start",
      fill: "currentColor", fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600,
      stroke: dark ? "#0E1A2E" : "#F7F9FB", strokeWidth: 3, paintOrder: "stroke"
    })
  ]
})
```

    <a class="more" href="research.qmd#mechanisms">About SV-eQTL mapping</a>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="aim">Aim 3</div>

</div>

## Why this matters

Populations of the Americas carry alleles found nowhere else, some with clear medical consequences. Yet available pangenomes include no reference populations of Indigenous American ancestry, and Latin American populations are strongly substructured. Without a regional reference, the variation that drives health differences across the region stays invisible.
